Subject: Paygrade appeal + equity realignment for Priya Natarajan

Hi Laura / Monica —

Opening this thread to request an exception approval for Priya (IC4, Search Relevance). TL;DR: Priya has taken on a persistent scope increase over the last 9 months (owns two cross-product ranking pilots, plus ad-hoc infra stabilization for the re-ranking pipeline). We lost a peer on the team to a counteroffer last month and Priya has had multiple retention signals.

Request:
- One-time equity refresh: 1,200 RSUs (time-vested, 2yr cliff recommended) to correct an alignment gap vs internal comparator set.
- Merit increase: move from base pay band midpoint to +8% (exception to the standard cycle) effective 2026-09-01.

Rationale & impact:
- Direct ownership of the A/B pilot that improved CTR by 6% in production (linked tests in Drive).
- Replacing this candidate would be high risk / expensive given domain knowledge and ramp time.
- Peer comps show current total comp is ~18% below median for IC4 within similar search teams at benchmarks.

Attachments: compcase_priya_Q3_2026.pdf (comp analysis, manager calibration notes, org chart).

As next steps I need a documented exception approval (comp committee or HR sign-off) and payroll instruction for an amendment. Can we target review by EOD Aug 18 so we have time to finalize before the Sep 1 effective date? Happy to sync — I can join a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Engineering Manager, Search Relevance

Subject: Re: Paygrade appeal + equity realignment for Priya Natarajan

Thanks for the write-up, Rishi — good context. I pulled the calibration notes from Q2 and the compbench snapshots; a few quick asks before I can greenlight escalation to comp committee: 

1) Manager justification: please add two concrete examples of outcomes where Priya owned the end-to-end delivery (production metrics + impact). The compcase PDF is helpful but we need short bullets to include in the approval slide.
2) Org/role mapping: who is the true comparator set you used? Provide 2 internal and 2 external comps (company + title + comp numbers).
3) Retention risk: any outreach/offer history? Did recruiting/people ops flag active interest?

Proposed compromise if committee is sensitive: allow the equity refresh now and defer the full merit move to the next calibration cycle but grant an interim spot increase (one-time base stipend or spot bonus) until Sep comp cycle. That keeps payroll simpler and gives Priya a tangible retention signal immediately.

If you can get the bullets to me by Mon Aug 17 EOD I’ll assemble the approval matrix and loop the comp vendor for an independent fairness check. cc: Monica for HR-side payroll impacts.
